Title: Member of Entourage vs Change of Target

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
Vampire a does some action, member of entourage blocks succesfully,
vampire a wants to play change of target, what happens?

a) CoT can't be played because Member has burnt already and action
ended
b) CoT ends the action before Member's card text kicks in and member
doesn't burn
c) CoT ends the action and Member burns anyway to his card text?
d) Something totally different I couldn't think of?

Change of Target
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PAB2, LoB:PG2/PI2, KoT:U/PM3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked (play before combat, if
any). Untap the acting minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and end
the current action (it is not successful). This minion cannot perform
the same action again this turn.
Artist: Chris Stevens; Dan Frazier

Member of the Entourage
[HttB:R2]
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Daughter of Cacophony
Mortal with 2 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
This ally cannot take actions. During a (D) action directed at you,
this ally may burn 1 life to get +1 intercept. Burn this ally if he
successfully blocks a vampire (no combat occurs).
Artist: Phil Wohr

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
On Mar 15, 11:50 am, Klaital <klaita...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Vampire a does some action, member of entourage blocks succesfully,
> vampire a wants to play change of target, what happens?
>

> c) CoT ends the action and Member burns anyway to his card text?

As acting methuselah, you get to choose the order of effects. You may
choose to play CoT as you are being blocked(burning the ally per his
text), but before untap per CoT "before combat, if any." 99% sure on
that because you can CoT before Obedience can be played(just don't be
a jerk and try to fish for it before saying "oh, it's a change of
target, don't play that").

Brandon
